entries.title: Psalms 142:1
segments:
PSALM CXLII. 
 
  David complains to God and trusts in him, ver. 1-7   Maschil of David; A prayer when he was in the cave.

entries.title: Psalms 142:3
segments: V. 3. Knowest-So as to direct me to it.  My path-What paths I should chuse whereby I might escape.

entries.title: Psalms 142:4
segments: V. 4. Right-hand-The place where the patron or assistant used to stand.

entries.title: Psalms 142:7
segments: V. 7. Prison-Set me at liberty.  Compass-Shall flock to me from all parts, to rejoice and bless God with me and for me.
